meta.title: Launch in two countries now, or in one country later?

problem.statement: We can launch our new app in two countries now. Or we can wait six months and launch in one country.
problem.decisionQuestion: Do we launch in two countries now, or wait and launch in one country?
problem.stakes: High. The cost is tens of thousands.
problem.reversibility: Hard to undo after we spend the money

context.label: Option 1
context.value: Two countries now. The cost is about 80k.

context.label: Option 2
context.value: One country in six months. The cost is 30k.

assumptions: All amounts are in thousands (k). The currency is not stated.
A payoff is the money that the app earns before the cost. The tool subtracts the cost.
The six-month wait has no extra cost. If it has a cost, add it to the cost of option 2.

toolSelection.why: You gave chances and money amounts. The tool can compare the average result of each option. The pre-mortem then checks how the best plan can fail.

alsoConsider.name: One-way or two-way door
alsoConsider.why: Use it to find a smaller first launch that you can undo.

options.name: Wait and launch in one country
